categories.summary: This Discord chat segment shows minimal technical activity with primarily social greetings and off-topic messages. The only substantive exchange involved nekiyk questioning if the project is dead, to which om1d_sa responded that development is ongoing daily and directed users to monitor GitHub activity for proof of active development. The conversation included unrelated spam about rugpull schemes from oliva2556 and a job posting from fixer1123 seeking communication support for an international development team. No technical discussions, implementations, or problem-solving occurred during this segment. The key takeaway is confirmation that the project remains active with daily development work visible on GitHub.

helpInteractions.context: User concerned about project status and activity
helpInteractions.resolution: Confirmed project is in active daily development and directed to GitHub for monitoring activity

categories.summary: The channel discussed two main technical topics. First, tcgkylee inquired about connecting to LMstudio and quickly resolved it independently by finding the official plugin at github.com/elizaOS/eliza/tree/develop/plugins/plugin-lmstudio. The more substantial discussion came from paulf76, who shared a newly developed trading agent plugin called cabal-hunter. The plugin addresses a critical blind spot in trading agents: identifying malicious actors and risky token structures that price/volume data alone cannot detect. The plugin performs on-chain wallet graph analysis to trace holder clusters, funding sources, bundled buyers, serial-rug deployers, and honeypot LPs (including freeze authority and token-2022 traps). It provides a verdict that agents can use to gate buy decisions. The plugin is available via npm as elizaos-plugin-cabal-hunter with the first 100 scans free, requiring approximately 3 lines of code to integrate. The developer is actively seeking feedback from other trading agent operators on additional signals to incorporate before buy decisions.

faqs.question: Is there a way to connect to LMstudio?
What other signals would you want the cabal-hunter plugin checking before a buy?

helpInteractions.resolution: Confirmed it was possible, tcgkylee found the solution via the official plugin repository

actionItems.description: Add additional buy signals to cabal-hunter plugin based on community feedback for trading agents
